name: @glance-apps/mcp-bridge
description: stdio to Streamable HTTP bridge for the GLANCE apps' MCP servers (dayGLANCE, lastGLANCE). A stateless pipe: tools and data live in the app.

scripts.mcpb:pack: node scripts/stage-mcpb.mjs dayglance && npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack dist-mcpb/dayglance dist-mcpb/dayglance-mcp-bridge.mcpb && node scripts/stage-mcpb.mjs lastglance && npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack dist-mcpb/lastglance dist-mcpb/lastglance-mcp-bridge.mcpb
scripts.mcpb:check: node scripts/check-mcpb.mjs dist-mcpb/dayglance-mcp-bridge.mcpb && node scripts/check-mcpb.mjs dist-mcpb/lastglance-mcp-bridge.mcpb
scripts.mcpb: npm run mcpb:pack && npm run mcpb:check

author: GLANCE Apps
